title: Schneider Electric Wonderware Historian
overview: VULNERABILITY OVERVIEW CREDENTIALS MANAGEMENT CWE-255 Wonderware Historian creates logins with default passwords, which can allow a malicious entity to compromise Historian databases. In some installation scenarios, resources beyond those created by Wonderware Historian may be compromised as well. CVE-2017-5155 has been assigned to this vulnerability. A CVSS v3 base score of 7.3 has been assigned; the CVSS vector string is ( AV:N/AC:L/PR:N/UI:N/S:U/C:L/I:L/A:L ). RESEARCHER Ruslan Habalov and Jan Bee of the Google ISA Assessments Team discovered this vulnerability. This product is provided subject to this  Notification  and this  Privacy & Use  policy.
